selection.selection_rule: Highest weighted dev episode success including the unchanged initialization; ties prefer higher PP success, then Basic success, then initialization, then arm declaration order.

experiment.dev_selection_note: Rule recomputed from recorded dev scores; no heldout outcomes used. This script does not rerun dev models.

policy.head: unchanged original vocabulary output embeddings; no project decision head
policy.probability_semantics: next-token distribution conditional on an offered A-D token; not task-success probability
policy.prompt: unchanged full standard policy_request rendered by the existing native baseline prompt; official chat template, enable_thinking=False
policy.forced_singletons: Code action; no model forward; consumes one controller RNG draw

api_accounting.scope: Includes prior journal exactly once in shard zero; zero reported cost is not independent billing verification.
api_accounting.verification: Recomputed from the completed parallel manifest; not a live gateway balance or independent billing audit.

model.input: uint8 RGB HWC 120x160 -> nearest 72x128 -> CHW -> /255 -> saved RMS

policy.observation: Unmodified UnifiedDoomEnv 320x240 visible-label/player structured state with history_length=4 and installed new Freedoom materials. Expert pixels, hidden state and actions are never inserted into the student observation.

assets.scenario: Both environments load the identical installed ViZDoom 1.3.0 predict_position.cfg and scenario WAD; standard reward and terminal rules apply to both.

expert_reference.comparison_scope: PP RGB expert collection, greedy epsilon=0. Uses old-material synchronized rendering and recurrent pixel inputs. Not a same-observation or same-controller primary comparison.

notes: All primary runs cover the exact same complete frozen cases; no result-dependent filtering.
Macro weights are Maze 1/3, Snake 1/3, Basic 1/6 and PP 1/6; no 548-case micro-average headline.
Wilson intervals describe episode-level rates; exact McNemar tests use paired episode outcomes.
Expert-action fit is not eventual-success calibration. No probability-calibration claim is made here.
Controller and recorded physical counters are verified; independent simulator replay is a separate artifact.
